abstract: Trichosanthin is the active protein component in the Chinese herb Trichosanthes kirilowi, which has distinct pharmacological properties. The cytotoxicity of trichosanthin was demonstrated by its selective inhibition of various choriocarcinoma cells. When Jar cells were treated with trichosanthin, the influx of calcium into the cells was observed by confocal laser scanning microscopy. When the distribution of trichosanthin-binding proteins on Jar cells was studied, two classes of binding sites for trichosanthin were shown by radioligand binding assay. Furthermore, the cytoplasmic membrane of Jar cells was biotinylated and the trichosanthin-binding proteins were isolated with trichosanthin-coupled Sepharose beads. Two protein bands with molecular masses of about 50 kDa and 60 kDa were revealed, further characterization of which should shed light on the mechanism of the selective cytotoxicity of trichosanthin to Jar cells.
abstract_ja: トリチョサンチンは中国の生薬Trichosanthes kirilowiに含まれる活性タンパク質で、特徴的な薬理作用を持つ。トリチョサンチンは各種絨毛癌細胞を選択的に阻害することで細胞毒性を示す。Jar細胞にトリチョサンチンを処理すると、共焦点レーザー走査顕微鏡でカルシウムの細胞内流入が観察された。放射性リガンド結合アッセイにより、トリチョサンチン結合部位が2つのクラスで存在することが示された。さらに、Jar細胞の細胞膜をビオチン化し、トリチョサンチンを結合させたセファロースビーズを用いて結合タンパク質を単離した。約50kDaと60kDaの2本のタンパク質バンドが検出され、今後の詳細な解析により、トリチョサンチンがJar細胞に選択的な細胞毒性を示す機序の解明につながることが期待される。
